description: Scan up to 10 public domains in one call: for each domain, the Sellular visibility score (0-100, A-F) and whether llms.txt exists, plus directory opportunities. Returns partial results with a per-domain error instead of failing the whole batch. Debits the rate limiter once per domain (results cache 24h per domain). Use for outreach research across a prospect list.

domains.description: 1-10 domains or full URLs to scan.

name: bulk_scan
